description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FileNotFoundException' which is used when a file cannot be located within the ZipStream library. It extends the base 'Exception' class in the namespace 'ZipStream\Exception' and customizes the constructor to accept a file path and generate an appropriate error message.

classes.name: FileNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a specific file cannot be found, extends the base Exception class in the zipstream exception namespace.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message indicating the file path that was not found.
